interface.shortDescription: 独立安装的价值投资研究英文分支
interface.longDescription: 基于 FernandoAbishai/ai-value-investing-agents 1.2.0。中英文完整研究默认与已启用的伯克希尔团队协作。可显式仅用 AIVA。 Based on AI Value Investing Agents 1.2.0. Full research in English or Chinese defaults to joint mode with Berkshire Team when enabled. AIVA-only mode remains available by request.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $aiva 与原伯克希尔联合研究我指定的公司并遵守我的报告顺序；没有公司名时先询问。
Use $aiva to research my chosen company in English using the joint Berkshire and AIVA workflow. Ask for the company if I haven’t named one.
